seoTitle: Hide or Unhide Purchase History on eBay
metaDescription: eBay doesn't allow permanent deletion of purchase history, but this guide shows how to hide, archive, and later unhide orders on web and mobile.
intro: eBay doesn't let you permanently delete purchase history, but you can hide or archive orders to keep your account cleaner and more private, then unhide them later if needed. This guide covers moving orders to the hidden list and restoring them when you want to see them again.

steps.heading: Open My eBay Purchase History
steps.body: Go to the Purchase History section under My eBay to see all your orders.

steps.heading: Select the orders to hide
steps.body: Choose the specific purchases you want to remove from your main list.

steps.heading: Move them to the hidden or archived list
steps.body: Use the available option to archive or hide the selected orders so they no longer appear in your default view.

steps.heading: Unhide items later if needed
steps.body: You can return to the archived or hidden list at any time and restore an order back to your main purchase history.

steps.heading: Repeat on web or mobile
steps.body: The same hide and unhide process works whether you're using the eBay website or the mobile app.

steps.heading: Know what stays visible to eBay
steps.body: Hiding an order only changes what you see in your regular view — the order information remains visible to eBay itself.

faq.question: Can I permanently delete purchase history on eBay?
faq.answer: No, eBay doesn't allow permanent deletion, but you can hide or archive orders to remove them from your main view.

faq.question: How do I unhide a purchase I archived?
faq.answer: You can go back to the hidden or archived list in Purchase History and restore the order to your main view.

faq.question: Does hiding an order delete it from eBay's records?
faq.answer: No, hiding an order only affects what's visible to you — the information remains on file with eBay.

faq.question: Can I hide gift orders from a shared account?
faq.answer: Yes, hiding orders is useful for protecting gift purchases or keeping a shared account tidy.

faq.question: Does this work the same on the mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes, you can hide and unhide purchases the same way on both the eBay website and mobile app.
